headline: Executive order signed October 22, 2026, aimed at lowering housing costs, though no details beyond its title are available.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order is meant to reduce what Americans pay for housing. No summary or text was provided, so it is not clear which federal agencies, programs, or rules it changes. It also is not clear whether it covers renting, buying, building, or financing homes.

who_it_affects.group: People who rent or buy homes
who_it_affects.how: The title says the order is meant to lower housing costs, but the specific effects on renters and buyers are not described in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the available information. Executive orders often take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
